title: Train Cellpose
description: Prepare matched microscopy images and reviewed object masks, configure CPSAM fine-tuning, and save a reproducible Cellpose checkpoint.
objectives: Prepare matching TIFF image-mask pairs in the required training folders.
Review starting point, schedule, geometry, denoising, and runtime categories.
Run a short calibration fit and locate the saved checkpoint and settings.
prerequisite: Create accurate instance-label masks, review every annotation, and reserve independent fields for validation before production training.

scenes.narration: Train Cellpose fine-tunes a CPSAM segmentation model from paired microscopy images and instance-label masks. The console reports the selected data, training progress, checkpoint path, and reproducibility record.
scenes.speech_text: Train Cellpose fine tunes a C P Sam segmentation model from paired microscopy images and instance label masks. The console reports the selected data, training progress, checkpoint path, and reproducibility record.

scenes.narration: The chat field accepts local workflow questions. Enable AI for a configured provider, and use the adjacent arrow to select a provider or open its controls.

scenes.narration: Drop the dataset root containing train, images and train, masks. Matching TIFF filenames form each pair. This demonstration derives six five-hundred-twelve-pixel cell fields from the real tutorial experiment; production labels must be independently reviewed.

scenes.narration: Essentials keeps the starting weights, model name, epoch count, learning rate, image target size, and verbose output visible for a first calibration run.
scenes.speech_text: Essentials keeps the starting weights, model name, epoch count, learning rate, image target size, and verbose output visible for a first calibration run.

scenes.narration: Modified limits the panel to intentional changes. Here, one epoch, a point-zero-one learning rate, batch size two, resizing, and a two-hundred-fifty-six-pixel target keep the tutorial fast and reproducible.
scenes.speech_text: Modified limits the panel to intentional changes. Here, one epoch, a point zero one learning rate, batch size two, resizing, and a two hundred fifty six pixel target keep the tutorial fast and reproducible.

scenes.speech_text: All settings reveals five categories: Starting Point, Training Schedule, Image Geometry, Background and Denoising, and Output and Runtime.

scenes.narration: Recipes saves the complete training configuration under a name, reapplies it to another annotated dataset, or imports and exports a reusable settings file.

scenes.narration: Starting Point chooses CPSAM, fine-tuning or training from scratch, and the checkpoint name. Fine-tuning pretrained weights usually needs far fewer reviewed images than a random start.

scenes.narration: Training Schedule sets epochs, learning rate, weight decay, minibatch size, and augmentation. Increase training only after the input pairs and held-out evaluation strategy are correct.

scenes.narration: Image Geometry records the source dimensions, target size, expected object diameter, and whether pairs are resized. Images and masks are transformed together, with label identities preserved.

scenes.narration: For this calibration, one epoch and batch size two process all six annotated fields without augmentation. A real fit should use enough epochs and image diversity to converge without memorizing the training set.

scenes.narration: Run validates matching filenames, loads every annotated image, previews a bounded sample, and fine-tunes the model. Stop requests a safe interruption while the current batch finishes.
